7UTZ: Those Gursikhs, with whom the Lord is pleased, accept the Word of the True Guru.
The Guru's disciples, with whom the Lord is pleased, they accept the True Guru's word.
WP92: Those Gurmukhs who meditate on the Naam are imbued with the four-fold color of the Lord's Love. ||12||
The Guru-wards who meditate on the Name, they are imbued with the four-fold colour of Lord's love.
Y3M5: The self-willed manmukh is cowardly and ugly; lacking the Name of the Lord, his nose is cut off in disgrace.
The perverse person, bereft, of the Name, is cowardly, ugly and noseless (sans honour).
1SLZ: Night and day, he is engrossed in worldly affairs, and even in his dreams, he finds no peace.
Night and day, he is engrossed in worldly affairs and gets not peace even in his dream.
DU31: O Nanak, if he becomes Gurmukh, then he shall be saved; otherwise, he is held in bondage, and suffers in pain. ||1||
Nanak if he is resigned to Guru's will, then, is he saved, otherwise, he is bound and suffers pain.
6XSZ: The Gurmukhs always look beautiful in the Court of the Lord; they practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
The pious ever look beauteous in the Lord's court and they practise the Guru's word.
HNQP: There is a lasting peace and happiness deep within them; at the Court of the True Lord, they receive honor.
Within them is lasting peace and comfort and they receive honour in the True-Lord's court.
TFNJ: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are blessed with the Name of the Lord; they merge imperceptibly into the True Lord. ||2||
Nanak, Guru-wards are blessed with the God's Name and they easily merge in he True One.
1SBB: As Gurmukh, Prahlaad meditated on the Lord, and was saved.
Through the Guru Prahlad contemplated on God and obtained salvation.
JQ40: As Gurmukh, Janak lovingly centered his consciousness on the Lord's Name.
By Guru's grace, Janak embraced affection for God's Name.
NP3A: As Gurmukh, Vashisht taught the Teachings of the Lord.
By Guru's grace, Washishat preached the Lord's sermon.
L40S: Without the Guru, no one has found the Lord's Name, O my Siblings of Destiny.
Without the Guru, none has obtained the Lord's Name O my brother.
1TY6: The Lord blesses the Gurmukh with devotion. ||13||
It is through the Guru, that God blesses man with His devotional service.
QS1H: One who has no faith in the True Guru, and who does not love the Word of the Shabad,
He, who has no faith in the True Guru, and enshrines not affection for the Name.
QP77: shall find no peace, even though he may come and go hundreds of times.
Peace accrues not to him, even you he may come and go hundreds of times.
JE0E: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meets the True Lord with natural ease; he is in love with the Lord. ||1||
Nanak, contracting love with the True Lord, the Guru ware easily meets with him.
6GZX: O mind, search for such a True Guru, by serving whom the pains of birth and death are dispelled.
O man, search you such a True Guru, by serving whom the pain of birth and death is dispelled.
5G84: Doubt shall never afflict you, and your ego shall be burnt away through the Word of the Shabad.
Then doubt shall never befall you and your egotism shall be burnt through the Name.
90K7: The veil of falsehood shall be torn down from within you, and Truth shall come to dwell in the mind.
The screen of falsehood shall be torn off from within you and truth shall come and abide in your mind.
YL5K: Peace and happiness shall fill your mind deep within, if you act according to truth and self-discipline.
By doing deeds in accordance with the ways of truth there shall be peace and comfort in your mind.
WZBZ: O Nanak, by perfect good karma, you shall meet the True Guru, and then the Dear Lord, by His Sweet Will, shall bless you with His Mercy. ||2||
Nanak, by perfect destiny the true Guru is met and then the sire Lord of His own sweet will blesses man with His mercy.
SDVS: The whole world comes under the control of one whose home is filled with the Lord, the King.
He, in whose home, God, the Lord, abides under his sway comes the whole world.
FNJC: He is subject to no one else's rule, and the Lord, the King, causes everyone to fall at his feet.
He bears subservience to none and God, the ruler, makes all fall at his feet.
ZT3V: One may run away from the courts of other men, but where can one go to escape the Lord's Kingdom?
One can run away and flee from men's courts, but where can one go out of the Lord's kingdom?
YM84: The Lord is such a King, who abides in the hearts of His devotees; He brings the others, and makes them stand before His devotees.
He is such God, the King who abides in the saints' mind that bringing all the remaining ones, He has make them stand before the saints.
ਬਾਕੀ ਬਚੇ ਹੋਏ ਜੋ ਅਜੇ ਤਕ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਪੈਰੀਂ ਲੱਗਣ ਤੋਂ ਝਕਦੇ ਸਨ
FQEE: The glorious greatness of the Lord's Name is obtained only by His Grace; how few are the Gurmukhs who meditate on Him. ||14||
The glory of God's Name is obtained through His grace, Only a few Guru-wards meditate on Him.
7PP0: Without serving the True Guru, the people of the world are dead; they waste their lives away in vain.
Without serving the True Guru, the men are dead and they waste their life in vain.
9BM3: In love with duality, they suffer terrible pain; they die, and are reincarnated, and continue coming and going.
In duality, they suffer severe pain, die, are born again and continue coming and going.
XAKY: They live in manure, and are reincarnated again and again.
They abide in ordure and are cast into existences again and again.
PUYX: O Nanak, without the Name, the Messenger of Death punishes them; in the end, they depart regretting and repenting. ||1||
Nanak, without the Name, the death's courier punishes them and they ultimately depart repenting.
PKU1: In this world, there is one Husband Lord; all other beings are His brides.
In this world there is but one Spouse; the rest, all others are His brides.

FKGZ: He enjoys the hearts of all, and yet He remains detached; He is unseen; He cannot be described.
He enjoys within the mind of all and yet remains separate from them. He is invisible and cannot be comprehended.
FM6Y: The Perfect Guru reveals Him, and through the Word of His Shabad, we come to understand Him.
The Perfect Guru shows Him, and through the Guru's hymns, we realise Him.
8NSV: Those who serve their Husband Lord, become like Him; their egos are burnt away by His Shabad.
They, who serve the Perfect Lord, through the Name, burn their egotism, and themselves become perfect.
T2CC: He has no rival, no attacker, no enemy.
He has no rival, no molester and no enemy.
UKYG: His rule is unchanging and eternal; He does not come or go.
Ever immovable is His empire and he neither comes nor goes.
SWUA: Night and day, His servant serves Him, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.
Night and day, the servant perform His service and sings the praise of the True Lord.
2Y5B: Beholding the Glorious Greatness of the True Lord, Nanak blossoms forth. ||2||
Beholding the greatness of the True God, Nanak has bloomed.
23QM: Those whose hearts are forever filled with the Name of the Lord, have the Name of the Lord as their Protector.
They within whose mind God's Name ever abides, God's Name becomes their saviour.
43EE: The Lord's Name is my father, the Lord's Name is my mother; the Lord's Name is my helper and friend.
God's Name is my father, name my mother and God's Name is my helper and friend.
TSSA: My conversation is with the Lord's Name, and my counseling is with the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name always takes care of me.
With God's Name is my conversation, with the God's Name my counsel, and the God's Name ever takes care of me.
Q3NT: The Lord's Name is my most beloved society, the Lord's Name is my ancestry, and the Lord's Name is my family.
The Lord's Name is my extremely dear society, the Lord's Name is my lineage and the Lord's Name my family.
S02T: The Guru, the Lord Incarnate, has bestowed upon servant Nanak the Name of the Lord; in this world, and in the next, the Lord ever saves me. ||15||
To slave Nanak, the image of God, the Guru, has conferred the Lord's Name. The Lord ever redeems me in this world and the world beyond.
VTDQ: Those who meet the True Guru, ever sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.
They, whom the True Guru meets, ever engage in singing the Lord's praise.
BBZV: The Lord's Name naturally fills their minds, and they are absorbed in the Shabad, the Word of the True Lord.
God's Name automatically abides in their mind and, in the True Name, they are absorbed.
H1Q7: They redeem their generations, and they themselves obtain the state of liberation.
They save their lineage and themselves obtain the status of salvation.
QS36: The Supreme Lord God is pleased with those who fall at the Guru's Feet.
The Exalted Lord is pleased with the persons, who fall at the Guru's feet.
FG52: Servant Nanak is the Lord's slave; by His Grace, the Lord preserves his honor. ||1||
Attendant Nanak, is the Lord's slave, and by His grace, God preserves his honour.
V8B5: In egotism, one is assailed by fear; he passes his life totally troubled by fear.
In pride, man is overtaken by fear, In utter commotion he passes his life.
M68U: Egotism is such a terrible disease; he dies, to be reincarnated - he continues coming and going.
Pride is a great malady because of which, he dies, is re-born and continues coming and going.
UWUC: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny meet with the True Guru, God Incarnate.
They, who are so pre-ordained, them, the Lord-incarnate Satguru comes and meets.
2URV: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, they are redeemed; their egos are burnt away through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||
Nanak, they age redeemed by Guru's grace and burn their egotism through the Name.
83DY: The Lord's Name is my immortal, unfathomable, imperishable Creator Lord, the Architect of Destiny.
God's Name is my immortal, incomprehensible, imperishable and Omnipotent Creator-Lord.
F7WU: I serve the Lord's Name, I worship the Lord's Name, and my soul is imbued with the Lord's Name.
God's Name I remember, God's Name I worship and with the God's Name my soul is imbued.
N3C0: I know of no other as great as the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name shall deliver me in the end.
I know not of any other so great as God's Name. God's Name shall deliver me in the end.
HNKG: The Generous Guru has given me the Lord's Name; blessed, blessed are the Guru's mother and father.
The beneficent Guru has given me the God's Name. Blessed! blessed are Guru's father and mother.
MDYC: I ever bow in humble reverence to my True Guru; meeting Him, I have come to know the Lord's Name. ||16||
I, ever bow before my True Guru, meeting whom, I have realised the Lord's Name.
C1G1: One who does not serve the Guru as Gurmukh, who does not love the Lord's Name,
He, who serves not the Holy Guru, embraces not affection for the Lord's Name,
LW5A: and who does not savor the taste of the Shabad, shall die, and be reborn, over and over again.
and enjoys not the relish of the Guru's hymns, transmigrates over and over again.
ZTGL: The blind, self-willed manmukh does not think of the Lord; why did he even come into the world?
The blind infidel meditates not on the Lord. why did he come into this word?
WZ6K: O Nanak, that Gurmukh, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, crosses over the world-ocean. ||1||
Nanak, to whom the Lord shows mercy, they, through the Guru, ferry across the world ocean.
3AF4: Only the Guru is awake; the rest of the world is asleep in emotional attachment and desire.
The Guru alone is awake. The rest of the world is asleep in worldly love and desire.
DVK6: Those who serve the True Guru and remain wakeful, are imbued with the True Name, the treasure of virtue.
They, who are imbued with the virtues, ever serve the True Guru and remain wakeful.

6PXC: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not think of the Lord; they are ruined through birth and death.
The blind apostates remember not the Lord and in births and deaths, they are ruined.
06YZ: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is their destiny, pre-ordained by the Primal Lord God. ||2||
Nanak, through the Guru, they alone reflect over the Name, in whose lot it is so pre-ordained by the Primal Lord.
GD1A: The Lord's Name is my food; eating the thirty-six varieties of it, I am satisfied and satiated.
NAGX: The Lord's Name is my clothing; wearing it, I shall never be naked again, and my desire to wear other clothing is gone.
God's Name is my raiment, wearing which I shall never be naked again and my desires to wear aught else be destroyed.
XKAH: The Lord's Name is my business, the Lord's Name is my commerce; the True Guru has blessed me with its use.
The Lord's Name is my trade, the Lord's Name my commerce and the employment of the Lord's Name, the True Guru has blessed me with.
G5GT: I record the account of the Lord's Name, and I shall not be subject to death again.
I record the account of the Lord's Name and my entire future subservience to death is annulled.
LKLT: Only a few, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord's Name; they are blessed by the Lord, and receive their pre-ordained destiny. ||17||
It is by Guru's grace, that some, who are the recipients of God's benevolence and who are so ordained, meditate on the Lord's Name.
EH5J: The world is blind and ignorant; in the love of duality, it engages in actions.
The world is ignorant and blind and it is engaged in other's love (false pursuits).
GDUF: But those actions which are performed in the love of duality, cause only pain to the body.
All those acts that the man performs through duality, lead to pain which swiftly stick to his body.
P7GB: By Guru's Grace, peace wells up, when one acts according to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
By Guru's grace, peace is produced, when the mortal meditates on the Guru's word.
4577: He acts according to the True Word of the Guru's Bani; night and day, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
He does the deeds enjoined by the True Gurbani, and night and day, remembers the Name.
6TJK: O Nanak, as the Lord Himself engages him, so is he engaged; no one has any say in this matter. ||1||
Nanak, he engages in what is God Himself engages him. He has no say in the matter.
G19M: Within the home of my own being, is the everlasting treasure of the Naam; it is a treasure house, overflowing with devotion.
In my home is the everlasting treasure of the Name, as also the brimful store of devotion.
SE2M: The True Guru is the Giver of the life of the soul; the Great Giver lives forever.
The True Guru is the giver of spiritual life and He, the donor, ever lives.
SLA8: Night and day, I continually sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise, through the Infinite Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Through the infinite hymns of the Guru, night and day, I, ever, sing the praise of the Lord.
TKAN: I recite continually the Guru's Shabads, which have been effective throughout the ages.
Ever recite I the hymns of the Guru, whose will works all the ages through.
T1S3: This mind ever abides in peace, dealing in peace and poise.
This soul of mine ever abides in peace and in contentment, deals in the Lord's Name.
B6H2: Deep within me is the Guru's Wisdom, the Lord's jewel, the Bringer of liberation.
Within me is the Guru-given gnosis of the Lord, the Gem, which does emancipated me.
BRCS: O Nanak, one who is blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace obtains this, and is judged to be True in the Court of the Lord. ||2||
Nanak, he to whom God shows favour, he obtains this gift and he is adjudged true in the Lord's court.
7911: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who goes and falls at the Feet of the True Guru.
Blest! blest! is accounted that Gursikh, who, from his mouth, utters the Name of the Lord God.
0R2T: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who with his mouth, utters the Name of the Lord.
Blessed! blessed! is accounted that Gursikh, whose soul is pleased by hearing the Lord's Name.
64Z9: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, whose mind, upon hearing the Lord's Name, becomes blissful.
Blessed! blessed! is said to be that Gursikh, who by serving the True Guru, obtains the Lord's Name.
9NQ3: Blessed, blessed is that Sikh of the Guru, who serves the True Guru, and so obtains the Lord's Name.
6SH0: I bow forever in deepest respect to that Sikh of the Guru, who walks in the Way of the Guru. ||18||
I ever make obeisance to that Gur-sikh, who treads in the Guru's path.
A4Y5: No one has ever found the Lord through stubborn-mindedness. All have grown weary of performing such actions.
Through mind's obstinacy, none has obtained the Lord. All have grown weary by engaging themselves in such acts.
SWCA: Through their stubborn-mindedness, and by wearing their disguises, they are deluded; they suffer in pain from the love of duality.
By mind's obstinacy and assuming false forms they are deluded and hence suffer pain through the love of another.
LGD5: Riches and the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas are all emotional attachments; through them, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not come to dwell in the mind.
Riches and miracles are all worldly attachment and hence the Name come not to abide in the mind.
5UKA: Serving the Guru, the mind becomes immaculately pure, and the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled.
By the Guru's service, the soul is rendered immaculate and the darkness of spiritual ignorance is dispelled.
5LZK: The jewel of the Naam is revealed in the home of one's own being; O Nanak, one merges in celestial bliss. ||1||
The Name jewel becomes manifest in the man's mind home, and he merges in celestial bliss, O Nanak.

9EFS: One who does not savor the taste of the Shabad, who does not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
He, who relishes not the Divine word, enshrines not affection for the Lord's Name,
P8K7: and who speaks insipid words with his tongue, is ruined, again and again.
and with his tongue utters insipid worlds he is ruined for ever and ever.
9SX5: O Nanak, he acts according to the karma of his past actions, which no one can erase. ||2||
Nanak, he acts according to his past actions which no one can erase.
RRJN: Blessed, blessed is the True Being, my True Guru; meeting Him, I have found peace.
Blessed! blessed! is my Satguru, the True person, meeting whom I have obtained peace.
HQX8: Blessed, blessed is the True Being, my True Guru; meeting Him, I have attained the Lord's devotional worship.
Blessed! blessed! is my Satguru, the person, meeting whom I have attained the Lord's meditation.
61YL: Blessed, blessed is the Lord's devotee, my True Guru; serving Him, I have come to enshrine love for the Name of the Lord.
Auspicious! auspicious! is my True Guru, the Lord's devotee, serving whom I have come to profess love for the God's Name.
NLCX: Blessed, blessed is the Knower of the Lord, my True Guru; He has taught me to look upon friend and foe alike.
Sublime, sublime is my True Guru, the Lord's divine, who has made me see the foe and friend with the same-eye.
ATG8: Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, my best friend; He has led me to embrace love for the Name of the Lord. ||19||
Praiseworthy! praiseworthy! is the True Guru, my friend, who has make me embrace love for the Lord's Name.
5RNW: The soul-bride is at home, while the Husband Lord is away; she cherishes His memory, and mourns His absence.
The bride is at home, her Groom is abroad and ever she remembers His and pines away.
Q7C8: She shall meet Him without delay, if she rids herself of duality. ||1||
She shall have no delay in meeting her groom, if she rids, her intention of duality.
DNWQ: O Nanak, false is the speech of one who acts without loving the Lord.
Nanak, false is the talk in which the man, bereft of Lord's love, engages himself.
JH4Y: He judges things to be good, only as long as the Lord gives and he receives. ||2||
So long as the Lord gives and he receives, till then, the mortal deems good as good.
NWBZ: The Lord, who created the creatures, also protects them.
The Lord who fashioned the creatures, that Lord protects them too.
6JM0: I have tasted the food of Ambrosial Nectar, the True Name.
I have partaken of the fare of the ambrosial True Name.
3CV0: I am satisfied and satiated, and my hunger is appeased.
I am sated and satiated and my desire to eat is stilled.
SJPF: The One Lord is pervading in all, but rare are those who realize this.
The One Lord pervades among all, but rare alone realises this thing.
4S3E: Servant Nanak is enraptured, in the Protection of God. ||20||
Seeking the protection of the Lord slave Nanak is enraptured.
FKPL: All the living beings of the world behold the True Guru.
All the mortals, that there are, of the world, behold the true Guru.
6RSD: One is not liberated by merely seeing Him, unless one contemplates the Word of His Shabad.
By merely seeing the Guru, one is not emancipated, until one reflects not on the Guru's hymns.
HJ3S: The filth of ego is not removed, and he does not enshrine love for the Naam.
His filth of ego is removed not, nor is the love for the Name implanted.
Z68S: The Lord forgives some, and unites them with Himself; they forsake their duality and sinful ways.
Some, the Lord forgives and unites with Himself. They forsake another's love and sin.
WEDM: O Nanak, some behold the Blessed Vision of the True Guru's Darshan, with love and affection; conquering their ego, they meet with the Lord. ||1||
Nanak, some, seeing the Satguru's sight with love and affection and killing their self, meet the Lord.
DGW8: The foolish, blind clown does not serve the True Guru.
The stupid and blind clown serves not the True Guru.
QMA6: In love with duality, he endures terrible suffering, and burning, he cries out in pain.
Through duality he suffers great pain and bewails burning therein.
WY3M: He forgets the Guru, for the sake of mere objects, but they will not come to his rescue in the end.
The objects for whose sake he forsake the Guru, they come not to his rescue in the end.
MNK1: Through the Guru's Instructions, Nanak has found peace; the Forgiving Lord has forgiven him. ||2||
By the Guru's instruction Nanak has attained peace and Lord, the Pardoner, has pardoned him.
Y52Z: You Yourself, all by Yourself, are the Creator of all. If there were any other, then I would speak of another.
You, by Yourself, alone are the Creator of all. Had there been a second, only then I would have talked about another.
KQQD: The Lord Himself speaks, and causes us to speak; He Himself is pervading the water and the land.
God Himself utters, Himself makes us utter and He Himself is pervading the ocean and the earth.
ABCV: The Lord Himself destroys, and the Lord Himself saves. O mind, seek and remain in the Lord's Sanctuary.
God Himself destroys and God Himself delivers. So, O my soul, remain you lying under God's protection.
QLNB: Other than the Lord, no one can kill or rejuvenate. O mind, do not be anxious - remain fearless.
Without God none can kill or animate. Therefore, O my soul, be unanxious and abide fearlessly.
08DT: While standing, sitting, and sleeping, forever and ever, meditate on the Lord's Name; O servant Nanak, as Gurmukh, you shall attain the Lord. ||21||1||Sudh||
Standing, sitting and sleeping for ever and aye, remember you God's Name and attain to God through the Guru, O slave Nanak.

3T4W: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
There is but One God. True is His Name and creative His personality He is without tear, without enmity, immortal in from, beyond birth and self-existent. by Guru's grace He is obtained.
NC5N: Sorat'h, First Mehl, First House, Chau-Padhay:
3NEA: Death comes to all, and all must suffer separation.
Death come to all and all must suffer separation.
KBXW: Go and ask the clever people, whether they shall meet in the world hereafter.
go and ask the wise whether the mortals shall meet hereafter or not.
0YLM: Those who forget my Lord and Master shall suffer in terrible pain. ||1||
They, who forget my Lord, shall suffer great pain.
6LDP: Ever praise you that True Lord,
GTZT: by whose Grace peace ever prevails. ||Pause||
by whose grace peace ever prevails. Pause.
X9A1: Praise Him as great; He is, and He shall ever be.
Deeming His great sing you His praise. He is and shall ever be.
ਵੱਡਾ ਕਰ ਕੇ, ਇਹ ਆਖ ਕੇ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਡਾ ਹੈ
5K8R: You alone are the Great Giver; mankind cannot give anything.
You alone are the Beneficent Lord of all. A man cannot make any gift.
RFAJ: Whatever pleases Him, comes to pass; what good does it do to cry out in protest? ||2||
Whatever pleases Him, that takes place. What can wailing like a woman achieve?
3FAE: Many have proclaimed their sovereignty over millions of fortresses on the earth, but they have now departed.
Good many have departed after having proclaimed sovereignty over millions of fortresses on earth.
L3SH: And those, whom even the sky could not contain, had ropes put through their noses.
They, whom the sky could not contain, had ropes put through their noses.

1GUF: O mind, if you only knew the torment in your future, you would not relish the sweet pleasures of the present. ||3||
O man, wert you to remember the prickles (future torments). why shoudest you relish the sweet (lure of sins).
ਤੂੰ ਮਿੱਠਾ ਖਾਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ, ਤੂੰ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੇ ਮਿੱਠੇ ਭੋਗ ਭੋਗਦਾ ਹੈਂ।
91HN: O Nanak, as many as are the sins one commits, so many are the chains around his neck.
Nanak as many as are the sins, so many are the chains around man's neck.
2KJJ: If he possesses virtues, then the chains are cut away; these virtues are his brothers, his true brothers.
If he possesses virtues, then his chains are cut off, those his brothers.
XHR1: Going to the world hereafter, those who have no Guru are not accepted; they are beaten, and expelled. ||4||1||
Reaching Yond, they, who are without the Guru, are not accepted. They are beaten and expelled.
W8Y0: Make your mind the farmer, good deeds the farm, modesty the water, and your body the field.
Make your mind the plough-man, good deed the farming, modesty the water and your body the field.
BYUU: Let the Lord's Name be the seed, contentment the plow, and your humble dress the fence.
Let Lord's Name be your seed, contentment the earth-crusher and garb of humility your fence.
XHVX: Doing deeds of love, the seed shall sprout, and you shall see your home flourish. ||1||
Doing deeds of love, the seed shall germinate and flourishing then you shall see such a home.
A8ZV: O Baba, the wealth of Maya does not go with anyone.
O sire, wealth goes not with the man.
XUMS: This Maya has bewitched the world, but only a rare few understand this. ||Pause||
This mammon has bewitched the world and some rare person understands this. Pause.
RG9X: Make your ever-decreasing life your shop, and make the Lord's Name your merchandise.
Make the ever-decreasing age your ship and make the Lord's True Name your merchandise.
6PK0: Make understanding and contemplation your warehouse, and in that warehouse, store the Lord's Name.
Make understanding and meditation your ware-house and in that ware-house, put you the True Name.
U727: Deal with the Lord's dealers, earn your profits, and rejoice in your mind. ||2||
Having dealings with the Lord's dealers and gaining the profit rejoice in your mind.
ਮਨ ਦਾ ਹਾਸਾ, ਮਨ ਦਾ ਖਿੜਾਉ।
VL0R: Let your trade be listening to scripture, and let Truth be the horses you take to sell.
Let the hearing of scriptures be your trade and truth the horses, you takest to sell.
047Q: Gather up merits for your travelling expenses, and do not think of tomorrow in your mind.
